delivery: Layered PNG alternative authorized by the artwork brief; mascot Lottie files are not included
registration: Stack the clean exports at x=0, y=0, equal width and height. Alignment corrections are baked into exports and recorded in processing-records.json. Do not trim individual layers.

successRig.notes: Revision 3: full-width lid follows the box perspective. Draw it over the back food/rim and under both hands and badge. Intentional hand/lid overlap gives foreground depth; do not shrink the lid to avoid the hand. Each eye remains separately registered, clear of mouth and food.

readingRig.notes: Render the same eye PNG twice, clipped at x=727. Blink each eye around its own pupil center. These clips pass only through transparent pixels; do not flatten the pair around the canvas center. Rotate the magnifier around its hand grip, rather than translating it away from the fixed hand.

easing.overshoot: Only the success hop and badge pop; keep other movement restrained

motionRecipes.name: success

steps.action: Squash body height from 100% to 96% around the body pivot
Hop upward 6% of displayed mascot height; lift lid
Show badge; scale 0.6 to 1.07 to 1 around badge pivot
Burst sparkle layer outward and fade; use code-drawn dots if individual control is needed
Settle and hold finished celebration poster

motionRecipes.implementationNote: Badge check is baked into the PNG; a 200ms check draw-on needs a code mask or vector check.

motionRecipes.name: launch-handoff

steps.action: Render the matching delivered 1024px splash PNG in the exact native splash image box
Optional lid lift up to 15 degrees, one wink and two fading sparkles
Scale the whole mark from 1 to 1.04 and fade opacity from 1 to 0

motionRecipes.implementationNote: The success rig is a different composition. Do not swap it into the splash at frame zero. Pixel-identical first-frame handoff requires the delivered splash PNG and matching native layout; isolated matching splash parts are not included.

motionRecipes.name: loading-loop
motionRecipes.implementationNote: Reuse the approved existing loader layers. The success-rig preview is a review aid, not a replacement for this neutral loop. The -4px rise is for a 160px displayed canvas; scale it proportionally.

reducedMotion: Skip movement and show the named finished still. Confetti uses confetti-last-frame.png, which is fully transparent. Run waiting loops only while the associated task is active.
status: Layer alignment reviewed in the browser. Motion recipes describe implementation work; native app integration and device acceptance are outside this artwork delivery.
